headline: Nigeria Considers 5% to 10% IPO for State Oil Giant NNPC
summary: Nigeria's state oil firm NNPC plans to sell 5% to 10% of itself in an initial public offering, primarily to local investors, following preparations slated for 2027.
why: NNPC is Nigeria's state-owned oil corporation, dominating the nation's energy sector and supplying a significant share of government revenues.

impacts.name: NNPC
impacts.why: The state oil firm is planning an IPO for up to 10% of its equity.
